description: This file provides utility functions for HTTP server responses, including setting security headers, sending JSON/text responses, handling errors, reading JSON request bodies, and configuring Server-Sent Events (SSE). It serves as a shared utility module within a web server codebase.

methods.name: export function setDefaultSecurityHeaders( setDefaultSecurityHeaders
methods.description: Applies security headers to the HTTP response, with optional strictTransportSecurity setting.

methods.description: Sends a plain text response with given status code and body.

methods.description: Sends a 405 Method Not Allowed response with an optional 'Allow' header.
